We devised an evaluation framework consisting of the six questions, shown in Table .
Evaluation framework consisting of six questions (Q1–Q6) covering well‑formedness, article style, stance, and arguments.

The first two questions pertain to the form of the generated text. Q1 measures whether the text is coherent, while Q2 focuses on the style, i.e., whether the text 'looks like' a news article. Q3 and Q4 are about the stance of the text towards the narrative -does the text support it and agree with it, or does it actively disprove it. Finally, Q5 and Q6 are measures of how many arguments for and against the narrative were generated by the LLM.
